# Atlan

> Atlan is the Context Layer for AI, providing an Enterprise Data Graph with AI-powered data discovery, governance, and metadata management across 100+ data stack integrations.

Atlan serves as a unified metadata and governance platform designed for modern data organizations. It combines data cataloging, lineage tracking, quality monitoring, and AI governance capabilities to help enterprises manage their data as a strategic asset in the age of AI.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise Data Graph
- Data Governance
- Metadata Management
- Data Catalog
- Column-Level Lineage
- AI Governance
- Data Quality
- Data Discovery
- Active Metadata
- Data Products
- AI Context
- Connectors Integration
- Data Contracts
- Knowledge Graph
- Workflow Automation

## Core Platform

- [Atlan - The Context Layer for AI](https://atlan.com): Atlan homepage: context layer for AI with Enterprise Data Graph
- [The Data Catalog of Choice for Enterprise AI | Atlan](https://atlan.com/data-discovery-catalog): AI-powered data catalog with lineage, quality, and governance
- [Open Metadata Lakehouse: Unified context engine for the future of AI & Analytics](https://atlan.com/metadata-lakehouse): Unified metadata lakehouse with open APIs and table formats

## Data Governance & Compliance

- [Active Data Governance | Atlan](https://atlan.com/active-data-governance): Community-centered data governance with privacy and enablement
- [AI Governance with Atlan](https://atlan.com/ai-governance): AI governance platform for compliance, model tracking, and policies
- [Data Quality by the Business, for the Business.](https://atlan.com/data-quality-studio): Data Quality Studio for defining and monitoring business-driven rules
- [Data Glossary & Business Metrics | Atlan](https://atlan.com/data-glossary): Knowledge graph-based glossary for business definitions and metrics

## Data Integration & Lineage

- [Column-Level Lineage on Atlan](https://atlan.com/column-level-lineage): Automated column-level lineage across 100+ connectors for impact analysis
- [Active Metadata for DataOps | Atlan](https://atlan.com/active-metadata): Active metadata platform for DataOps and data quality monitoring
- [Connectors | Atlan](https://atlan.com/connectors): Browse connectors to integrate with data stack platforms

## Automation & Workflow

- [Intelligent Automation | Atlan](https://atlan.com/intelligent-automation): Playbooks and automations for metadata management and governance
- [Atlan MCP - Connect Atlan to Your Favorite AI Tools](https://atlan.com/mcp-server): MCP integration for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agent workflows

## Data Products & Marketplace

- [The Amazon for Trusted Data Products | Atlan](https://atlan.com/data-products-marketplace): Marketplace for curating, governing, and consuming data products
- [Personalization & Curation | Atlan](https://atlan.com/personalization-and-curation): Personalize Atlan for user personas and business domains

## Developer & Setup

- [Atlan App Framework: Build Apps on Atlan, the Context OS for AI](https://atlan.com/app-framework): Developer framework for building apps on Atlan's Context OS
- [DIY Setup | Atlan](https://atlan.com/diy-setup): Quick-start guide for connecting data sources in 3 steps
